questions.stem: What are the roles of Git and GitHub?
questions.zhStem: Git 和 GitHub 各自的作用是什么？
options: GitHub is the version-control engine; Git is only its website.
Git tracks history locally; GitHub hosts repositories and adds pull requests and issues.
Git needs a network connection; GitHub works offline on each computer.
Git and GitHub are two names for the same Microsoft product.
questions.explain: Git is the local version-control system and GitHub is the hosting service around it, because Git records commits on your own computer while GitHub stores a shared copy and adds pull requests, issues and permissions.
questions.zhExplain: Git 是本地的版本控制系统，GitHub 是围绕它的托管服务，因为 Git 在你自己的电脑上记录提交，而 GitHub 保存共享副本并提供 pull request、issue 和权限等功能。

questions.stem: Which table compares at least three Git commands?
questions.zhStem: 哪个表格比较了至少三个 Git 命令？
options: status: shows state; add: records; commit: stages
status: shows state; add: stages; commit: records
status: stages; add: records; commit: shows state
status: records; add: shows state; commit: stages
questions.explain: git status shows the state, git add stages and git commit records, because add moves changes into the staging area and commit saves that staged snapshot in the history.
questions.zhExplain: git status 显示状态，git add 暂存，git commit 记录，因为 add 把改动放入暂存区，commit 把暂存的快照保存到历史中。

questions.stem: What does Git store in a commit?
questions.zhStem: Git 在一次 commit 中存储了什么？
options: A snapshot of tracked files, metadata such as author and message, and a parent pointer.
Only the lines that changed, with no author or time information.
A copy of the whole computer disk at that moment.
Only the commit message; the files stay in the working tree.
questions.explain: A commit records a snapshot, metadata and a pointer to its parent, because the snapshot keeps the file state, the metadata says who and when, and the parent pointer links commits into a history.
questions.zhExplain: 提交记录了快照、元数据和指向父提交的指针，因为快照保存文件状态，元数据说明是谁在何时提交，父指针把提交连成历史。

questions.stem: How do you stage, commit, push, and pull changes?
questions.zhStem: 如何暂存、提交、推送和拉取更改？
options: git commit, git add, git pull, git push
git save, git record, git upload, git download
git add, git commit, git push, git pull
git status, git switch, git merge, git clone
questions.explain: Use git add, git commit, git push and git pull, because add stages changes, commit records them, push uploads commits and pull downloads and merges remote commits.
questions.zhExplain: 使用 git add、git commit、git push 和 git pull，因为 add 暂存更改，commit 记录更改，push 上传提交，pull 下载并合并远程提交。

questions.stem: Why not create the entire assignment in one commit?
questions.zhStem: 为什么不把整个作业放在一次提交中完成？
options: It makes the repository smaller on GitHub.
The history shows how the work grew, and earlier states can be restored.
It removes the need to push the branch to GitHub.
It merges each section into main automatically.
questions.explain: Small commits give a useful history, because each commit is a saved snapshot, so the log shows how the report grew and any earlier state can be recovered.
questions.zhExplain: 小步提交能留下有用的历史，因为每次提交都是一个保存的快照，所以日志能显示报告如何逐步完成，也能恢复任何早期状态。

questions.stem: Why must your work for this lab be completed on the `lab-01` branch before it is merged into the default branch?
questions.zhStem: 为什么本实验的工作必须先在 `lab-01` 分支上完成，然后才合并到默认分支？
options: Work stays off main until it is reviewed and merged.
Commits on a branch do not need a commit message.
A branch uploads changes to GitHub without git push.
Branches delete the main branch after the work is finished.
questions.explain: A working branch keeps unreviewed changes away from main, because the branch must be reviewed and merged before its commits reach main.
questions.zhExplain: 工作分支能让未经评审的改动远离 main，因为分支必须先评审并合并，它的提交才会进入 main。

questions.stem: How do you push the branch to GitHub?
questions.zhStem: 如何把分支推送到 GitHub？
options: git pull origin lab-01
git commit -u origin lab-01
git merge origin lab-01
git push -u origin lab-01
questions.explain: Run git push -u origin lab-01, because push uploads the local commits to origin and -u sets origin/lab-01 as the upstream branch.
questions.zhExplain: 运行 git push -u origin lab-01，因为 push 把本地提交上传到 origin，-u 把 origin/lab-01 设为上游分支。

questions.stem: How do you create and merge a pull request?
questions.zhStem: 如何创建并合并 pull request？
options: Push main into lab-01, then close the pull request.
Create an issue, then merge the issue into main.
Open a pull request from lab-01 into main, review it, then merge it.
Fork the repository, then delete the lab-01 branch.
questions.explain: Open the pull request on GitHub and then merge it, because the pull request shows the branch's changes for review and the merge adds its commits to main.
questions.zhExplain: 在 GitHub 上创建 pull request 然后合并它，因为 pull request 显示该分支的改动供评审，合并会把它的提交加入 main。

questions.stem: Why review the Files changed tab?
questions.zhStem: 为什么要查看 Files changed 标签页？
options: It merges the pull request automatically after one look.
It shows every change in the pull request so errors can be fixed before merging.
It lists the collaborators who can see the repository.
It downloads the changed files to your computer.
questions.explain: Review it before merging, because the Files changed tab shows every line the pull request changes, so errors can be corrected first.
questions.zhExplain: 合并前要查看它，因为 Files changed 标签页显示 pull request 改动的每一行，所以可以先改正错误。

questions.stem: After you click Fork on a GitHub repository, where is the fork?
questions.zhStem: 在 GitHub 仓库上点击 Fork 后，fork 在哪里？
options: In the laptop's Downloads folder as a zip file.
On GitHub, as a copy of the repository under their account.
Inside the original repository as a new branch.
In the laptop's staging area, waiting for git add.
questions.explain: The fork is on GitHub under the intern's account, because a fork is a server-side copy of a repository, and getting files onto the laptop needs a separate git clone.
questions.zhExplain: fork 在 GitHub 上该实习生的账户下，因为 fork 是仓库在服务器端的副本，要把文件放到笔记本电脑上还需要另外执行 git clone。

questions.stem: Why use an email address connected to your GitHub account?
questions.zhStem: 为什么要使用一个电子邮件地址，并且它已关联到你的 GitHub 账户？
options: GitHub rejects pushes from any other email.
Git needs the email to encrypt each commit.
GitHub links each commit to an account by its email.
The email becomes the repository's password.
questions.explain: GitHub attributes a commit by matching its email address, because the author email stored in the commit must be an email on the GitHub account.
questions.zhExplain: GitHub 通过匹配提交的电子邮件地址来归属提交，因为提交中保存的作者邮箱必须是该 GitHub 账户上的邮箱。

questions.stem: What is a short explanation of Git, GitHub, and Markdown?
questions.zhStem: 对 Git、GitHub 和 Markdown 的简短解释是什么？
options: Git hosts repositories; GitHub records history; Markdown runs scripts.
Git formats documents; GitHub compiles code; Markdown tracks versions.
Git is a website; GitHub is an editor; Markdown is a database.
Git records history; GitHub hosts it; Markdown formats plain-text docs.
questions.explain: Git records the history, GitHub hosts and reviews it, and Markdown documents it, because a .md file is plain text that Git can diff and GitHub renders as HTML.
questions.zhExplain: Git 记录历史，GitHub 托管并评审它，Markdown 为它写文档，因为 .md 文件是纯文本，Git 可以逐行比较，GitHub 会把它渲染成 HTML。

questions.stem: How do you confirm your Git identity?
questions.zhStem: 如何确认你的 Git 身份？
options: git --version, then git status
git config --global user.name, then user.email
git branch, then git log
git remote -v, then git fetch
questions.explain: Run git config --global user.name and user.email, because these two values are the author name and email that Git writes into every commit.
questions.zhExplain: 运行 git config --global user.name 和 user.email，因为这两个值就是 Git 写入每次提交的作者姓名和邮箱。

questions.stem: What is the result of `git --version`?
questions.zhStem: 什么是 `git --version` 的结果？
options: The installed Git version, e.g. git version 2.53.0
The name and email set in git config
The current branch and its status
The latest commit on the remote
questions.explain: It prints the installed Git version, because --version only reports the version of the git program itself.
questions.zhExplain: 它输出已安装的 Git 版本，因为 --version 只报告 git 程序本身的版本。

keys: 已安装的 Git 版本

questions.stem: How do you clone and open a repository in Visual Studio Code?
questions.zhStem: 如何在 Visual Studio Code 中克隆并打开仓库？
options: Ctrl+Shift+P, Git: Push, paste the URL, then open it
Ctrl+Shift+P, Git: Fork, paste the URL, then open it
Ctrl+Shift+P, Git: Clone, paste the URL, then open it
Ctrl+Shift+P, Git: Init, paste the URL, then open it
questions.explain: Use Git: Clone from the Command Palette, because it copies the remote repository to a local folder and then offers to open it.
questions.zhExplain: 在命令面板中使用 Git: Clone，因为它会把远程仓库复制到本地文件夹，然后提示打开它。

questions.stem: How do you create and switch between Git branches?
questions.zhStem: 如何创建 Git 分支并在分支之间切换？
options: git branch -d to create, git merge to change
git init to create, git clone to change
git commit -b to create, git pull to change
git switch -c to create, git switch to change
questions.explain: Use git switch -c to create a branch and git switch to move between branches, because -c creates the new branch before switching to it.
questions.zhExplain: 用 git switch -c 创建分支，用 git switch 在分支之间切换，因为 -c 会先创建新分支再切换过去。

questions.stem: How do you confirm the active branch?
questions.zhStem: 如何确认当前活动分支？
options: git remote -v
git config --list
git branch
git push --dry-run
questions.explain: Run git branch, because it lists the local branches and marks the active one with an asterisk.
questions.zhExplain: 运行 git branch，因为它会列出本地分支，并用星号标出当前分支。

questions.stem: Why are repeated messages such as `update`, `change`, `test`, or `final` not considered meaningful?
questions.zhStem: 为什么像 `update`、`change`、`test` 或 `final` 这样重复的提交信息不被认为有意义？
options: They do not say what changed or why.
They are too long for Git to store.
Git rejects commits with one-word messages.
They break the link to the pull request.
questions.explain: Such messages are not meaningful, because they do not describe what each commit changed, so the history cannot show the progress.
questions.zhExplain: 这类信息没有意义，因为它们没有说明每次提交改了什么，所以历史无法显示进展。

questions.stem: Git and GitHub Workflow: what are the steps you completed?
questions.zhStem: Git 和 GitHub 工作流程：你完成了哪些步骤？
options: Merge, push, branch, commit, open a pull request
Commit to main, fork, delete the branch, push
Branch, commit in stages, push, open a pull request, merge
Push, branch, merge, then commit once at the end
questions.explain: The steps were branch, commit, push, pull request and merge, because the work stays on lab-01 until the reviewed pull request merges it into main.
questions.zhExplain: 步骤是创建分支、提交、推送、pull request 和合并，因为工作一直留在 lab-01 上，直到经过评审的 pull request 把它合并到 main。

keys: Git 和 GitHub 工作流程

questions.stem: How do you use multiple heading levels, including at least `#`, `##`, and `###`?
questions.zhStem: 如何使用多个标题级别，至少包括 `#`、`##` 和 `###`？
options: ### for the title, ## for sections, # for sub-sections
# for bold, ## for italic, ### for code
# for lists, ## for links, ### for tables
# for the title, ## for sections, ### for sub-sections
questions.explain: Use # for the title, ## for each section and ### inside a section, because more # signs make a lower heading level.
questions.zhExplain: 用 # 作为标题，## 作为各个部分，### 用在部分内部，因为 # 号越多，标题级别越低。

questions.stem: Which examples of bold, italic, bold and italic, and strikethrough text are correct?
questions.zhStem: 哪一组粗体、斜体、粗斜体和删除线文本的示例是正确的？
questions.explain: Use ** for bold, * for italic, *** for both and ~~ for strikethrough, because GitHub Flavored Markdown reads the number of * signs as the emphasis and ~~ as a deletion.
questions.zhExplain: 粗体用 **，斜体用 *，两者兼有用 ***，删除线用 ~~，因为 GitHub Flavored Markdown 按 * 号的个数判断强调，把 ~~ 当作删除。

questions.stem: How do you include an unordered list, an ordered list, and a nested list?
questions.zhStem: 如何加入无序列表、有序列表和嵌套列表？
options: 1. item, - item, and > item
- item, 1. item, and an indented - item
* item, # item, and | item |
[x] item, A. item, and --- item
questions.explain: Start lines with - for unordered, 1. for ordered and indent a - line for nesting, because Markdown builds a sub-list from an indented list item.
questions.zhExplain: 无序列表行以 - 开头，有序列表以 1. 开头，嵌套时把 - 行缩进，因为 Markdown 会把缩进的列表项变成子列表。

questions.stem: How do you include at least two useful links?
questions.zhStem: 如何加入至少两个有用的链接？
options: (Git documentation)[https://git-scm.com/doc]
<Git documentation>(https://git-scm.com/doc)
[Git documentation](https://git-scm.com/doc)
![Git documentation](https://git-scm.com/doc)
questions.explain: Write [text](URL) for each link, because Markdown shows the text in square brackets and links it to the URL in parentheses.
questions.zhExplain: 每个链接写成 [text](URL)，因为 Markdown 显示方括号里的文字，并把它链接到圆括号里的 URL。

questions.stem: How do you add at least one relevant screenshot or image using Markdown syntax and meaningful alternative text?
questions.zhStem: 如何用 Markdown 语法和有意义的替代文本添加至少一张相关截图或图片？
options: [Repository settings page](images/repo.png)
![Repository settings page](images/repo.png)
![](images/repo.png)
!(images/repo.png)[Repository settings page]
questions.explain: Use ![alt text](path) with a description in the brackets, because the alternative text tells readers and screen readers what the image shows.
questions.zhExplain: 使用 ![alt text](path) 并在方括号中写上描述，因为替代文本告诉读者和屏幕阅读器图片显示了什么。

questions.stem: How do you include a relevant note or quotation using a blockquote?
questions.zhStem: 如何用引用块加入相关的注释或引文？
options: - Clear documentation matters.
# Clear documentation matters.
| Clear documentation matters. |
> Clear documentation matters.
questions.explain: Start the line with >, because Markdown renders lines that begin with > as an indented quotation block.
questions.zhExplain: 在行首加上 >，因为 Markdown 会把以 > 开头的行渲染成缩进的引用块。

questions.stem: When do you use inline code?
questions.zhStem: 什么时候使用行内代码？
options: When writing a whole multi-line script
When adding a heading to a section
When referring to a command, file, branch, or technical value
When quoting a person's opinion
questions.explain: Use backticks around commands, file names, branches and values, because the code style shows the reader exactly what must be typed.
questions.zhExplain: 用反引号包住命令、文件名、分支和数值，因为代码样式能让读者看清必须准确输入的内容。

questions.stem: How do you include at least one fenced code block with a language identifier?
questions.zhStem: 如何加入至少一个带语言标识符的围栏代码块？
options: ``` on the first line, bash on the last
<bash> on the first line, </bash> on the last
> bash on each line
```bash on the first line, ``` on the last
questions.explain: Open the block with ```bash and close it with ```, because the word after the opening fence tells GitHub which syntax highlighting to apply.
questions.zhExplain: 用 ```bash 开始代码块，用 ``` 结束，因为开头围栏后的单词告诉 GitHub 使用哪种语法高亮。

questions.stem: How do you include a task list showing your progress?
questions.zhStem: 如何加入任务列表来显示你的进度？
options: [x] Done and [ ] To do
* (x) Done and * ( ) To do
- [x] Done and - [ ] To do
1. {x} Done and 2. { } To do
questions.explain: Write - [x] for a finished task and - [ ] for an open one, because GitHub renders these list items as checked and unchecked boxes.
questions.zhExplain: 已完成的任务写 - [x]，未完成的写 - [ ]，因为 GitHub 会把这些列表项渲染成已勾选和未勾选的方框。

questions.stem: How do you use a horizontal rule to separate major parts of the document?
questions.zhStem: 如何用水平分隔线分隔文档的主要部分？
options: A line with only ###
A line with only ---
A line with only >>>
A line with only ===
questions.explain: Put --- on its own line after a blank line, because GitHub renders it as a horizontal line across the page.
questions.zhExplain: 在空行之后单独一行写上 ---，因为 GitHub 会把它渲染成横跨页面的水平线。

questions.stem: What is at least one challenge, and how did you resolve it?
questions.zhStem: 至少一个遇到的挑战是什么，你是如何解决的？
options: First commits used the wrong email; renamed the lab-01 branch
The .git folder was locked; ran git push --force
First commits used the wrong email; set user.email and recreated the repository
gh login failed; made the repository public
questions.explain: One challenge was a wrong commit email, resolved by setting user.email before committing again, because GitHub links commits to an account by their email.
questions.zhExplain: 其中一个挑战是提交邮箱错误，解决办法是在重新提交前设置 user.email，因为 GitHub 通过邮箱把提交关联到账户。

questions.stem: What do the References contain?
questions.zhStem: References（参考文献）部分包含什么？
options: The full text of every source
Only the course repository link
A list of the commands typed
Links to any external resources used
questions.explain: References list links to the external resources used, because readers must be able to check every outside source.
questions.zhExplain: References 列出所用外部资源的链接，因为读者必须能核对每一个外部来源。

questions.stem: Why confirm that no credentials or secrets appear in the repository or its commit history?
questions.zhStem: 为什么要确认仓库及其提交历史中没有出现凭据或密钥？
options: Secrets make the repository public.
GitHub deletes repositories with secrets.
Commit history is hidden from collaborators.
A deleted secret still remains in older commits.
questions.explain: Check the history too, because a secret removed in a later commit still remains in the earlier commits that anyone with access can read.
questions.zhExplain: 历史也要检查，因为在后来的提交中删除的密钥仍然留在更早的提交里，任何有权限的人都能读到。
